# Poly Haven textures (CC0)

`art/nation/mat/*.webp` are small grey detail maps made from these CC0 textures from https://polyhaven.com (licence: https://polyhaven.com/license):

plaster = white_rough_plaster, brick = red_brick_03, concrete = concrete_floor_worn_001, tile = clay_roof_tiles, asphalt = asphalt_02, paving = pavement_03, lawn = leafy_grass, grass = aerial_grass_rock, sand = coast_sand_01, wood = weathered_planks, rock = aerial_rocks_02.

Made with: 1K diffuse, greyscale, tone flattened, 512 px WebP.
